Background of the Merger
On January 1, 2022, the Chief Executive Officer of Party A contacted the Chief Executive Officer of Party B regarding a potential transaction.
On January 15, 2022, Party B submitted a non-binding indication of interest to acquire Party A for $100.00 to $110.00 per share in cash.
Recommendation of the Board of Directors
The Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote in favor of the merger.
Opinion of Example Advisor LLC
Example Advisor LLC rendered its opinion to the Board of Directors.
Discounted Cash Flow Analysis
Example Advisor selected a discount rate range of 8.0%-10.0% and derived an implied per share equity value range of $95.00 to $115.00.
